listings.d: Papa's RV Service is a one-man mobile RV service business that travels to the customer. It states it is dedicated to providing top-notch service for all RV needs and can get the RV fixed whether it is warranty work or not. It serves the top half of Delaware, northeastern Maryland and southern New Jersey. It is based at 1697 South Dupont Highway, Saint Georges, DE.
listings.region: Top Half of Delaware, North Eastern Maryland, and Southern New Jersey

coverage_quotes: Currently servicing the Top Half of Delaware, North Eastern Maryland, and Southern New Jersey .
evidence.type_quote: At Papa's RV Service, I am dedicated to providing top-notch service for all your RV needs.

listings.d: The RV Shop is an RV repair centre in New Castle, Delaware, in business more than 30 years, with a second facility opened in Laurel, DE in 2026. It offers both in-shop and mobile RV repair across Delaware, Pennsylvania, Maryland and New Jersey. Its services include A/C and appliance repair, awning and roof repair, electrical and plumbing work, generator service, suspension repair, collision and paint services and warranty repairs. It runs an 80,000-square-foot facility staffed by certified technicians.

coverage_quotes: Our repair facility provides premium mobile RV repair services to Delaware, Pennsylvania, Maryland, and New Jersey!
evidence.type_quote: From mobile RV repair to full paint refinishing, we offer a comprehensive range of services, including A/C and appliance repair, awning and roof repair, electrical and plumbing work, generator service, suspension repair, and more.

listings.d: East Coast Campers & More is an RV dealer with a service centre and parts department in Frankford, Delaware, at the corner of Rt. 113 and Parker Road. Its service team repairs and restores RVs, campers and trailers and covers mechanical adjustments, electrical systems, plumbing, roof repair and slide-out troubleshooting. It runs three Mobile RV Medic service vehicles that come to the customer's location anywhere on the Eastern Shore. It states it has the largest RV parts inventory on the Eastern Shore.

coverage_quotes: Our Mobile RV Medics can come to your location, and when you purchase a new RV from us, you’ll receive priority service at your site anywhere on the Eastern Shore!
evidence.type_quote: At East Coast Campers and More, our team of service experts can repair and restore your RV, camper, or trailer to make your vehicle function better than ever before.

listings.d: Parkview RV Center is an RV dealer in Smyrna, Delaware, providing RV service since 1968. Its service department has 10 full-service bays, each staffed by a certified technician, and offers after-hours drop-off. Its technicians are factory-trained and certified to work on all makes and models, and it handles factory-certified warranty work, extended service contracts and insurance work. It has earned recognition awards from Winnebago and RVIA.

evidence.type_quote: At Parkview RV Center we work hard to provide the best RV service in the area and our goal is the complete satisfaction of our customers.

listings.d: Delmarva RV Center is an RV dealer service operation with two Delaware locations and a 12,000-square-foot service centre. It provides RV service and repair near Dover with factory-trained technicians and advanced diagnostics. It handles preventive maintenance, appliance diagnostics and repair, plumbing and water systems, exterior sealant maintenance, walkaround inspections and insurance repairs and rebuilds. It services travel trailers, fifth wheels and motorhomes of any make or model.

coverage_quotes: With two Delaware locations serving customers across Delaware, Maryland, and Pennsylvania, Delmarva RV Center gives Dover-area owners a practical local option with broader support capacity.
evidence.type_quote: Delmarva RV Center provides road-ready RV service and RV repair near Dover with factory-trained technicians, advanced diagnostics, and clear next steps.
